'''Erodsis''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] and one of two [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the [[Christoph system/Legends|Christoph system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Erodsis was the second planet from the [[Christoph|star]], situated between two chaotic [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belts]], [[the Hammers]] and [[the Halo]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Erodsis was introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
